Label: Class soul
Line: The soul your class gave you. Click it to see what it does.
Note: Handed out at creation; its UPGRADE opens with the souls rung (T6 part 1: D "class soul earlier - at the beginning")

Label: Hatch All
Line: Hatches every egg in the bag in one go.
Note: Single hatch is open from floor 1 (B1 ruling 2026-09-09); the soul bag window (where eggs live) is open from floor 1 (hatch-access 2026-10-23); Floor 8 -> 6 (#1193 D 2026-11-03 "Hatch all on floor 6")

Label: Dismantle All
Line: Breaks many pieces into materials in one go.
Note: Single dismantle is open from floor 1 (B1 ruling 2026-09-09); Floor 8 -> 4 (#1193 D 2026-11-03 "dismantling eggs and souls needs to open way earlier, on floor 4")

Label: Autoplay
Note: The AUTOPLAY button on the floor; it opens when the FIRST BATTLE ENDS, won or lost (#1143 D 2026-11-02: "need to unlock autoplay after the first battle, not on floor 6"). Floor 1 is the floor it opens on; the gate is the client foughtOnce() - ftue.first_battle or any win on record

Label: Souls
Line: Souls live in their own bag. Seat one on gear for its power.
Note: The soul slot on equipment + the class soul's upgrade; the soul bag window itself is open from floor 1 so eggs hatch (hatch-access 2026-10-23); Floor 12 -> 5 (#1195 D 2026-11-03 "soul equipping should unlock on floor 5"); Devour keeps its own rung 12

Label: Async PvP
Line: Queue your team against other players' teams.
Note: The arena window and its MATCHMAKING (auto) queue

Label: Auto-optimise
Line: Wears the strongest pieces in your bag for you.

Label: Breeding
Line: Two creatures in a pen make eggs over time.
Note: The pens; eggs still drop and wait in the bag

Label: Grading
Note: Enhancement grading (Gem / Rune / Scroll); gear grading is taught in the scripted opening

Label: Shadow Trader
Line: Stock changes over time. Come back for new wares.

Label: Dimensional Rift
Line: The rift to Herumon Dungeon is open. Send a creature through: a copy, free, once. It arrives at level 1 and keeps its grade.
Note: T48 (D 2026-11-03 "build it! ... add it to the menu unlocks on beating level 100"): the DIMENSIONAL RIFT menu tile and the sheet action; Tower -> Dungeon only; the web build shows the tile and says the rift opens in the Steam client

Label: Gauntlets
Line: The gauntlets are open: five bosses back to back, HP carried, no healing. Each gauntlet gives one free run a week.

Label: Resource Dungeons
Line: The resource dungeons are open: three fights that pay one resource. Your first entry to each is free.
Note: M1-10 resource dungeons (board M1, lane m1resui 2026-11-05): the RESOURCE DUNGEONS menu entry opens at best floor 10, beside the gauntlets (the first level of each opens at best floor 1 server side and its daily key waits in /api/grants/pending until the window is read; the entry rides the ladder at 10 so the first floors teach the core loop before a second key-and-run system arrives)
